do.name: Walking the cathedral roofs
do.detail: A booked guided climb onto the stone decks above the nave, up by the rattle tower, looking down on the square and the old town.

do.name: Timed visit to the Portico da Gloria
do.detail: Small groups enter on the clock to see the restored Romanesque doorway and its carved figures, colour still on the stone.

do.name: Tapas crawl along the Rua do Franco
do.detail: Around eighty bars sit in one hundred and fifty metres, so a plate of octopus and a cup of Ribeiro per stop is the local way.

do.name: Buy at the Mercado de Abastos and have it cooked
do.detail: Eight granite halls of Atlantic fish and Galician cheese, where a stall next door will cook whatever you just bought.

do.name: Festas do Apostolo in late July
do.detail: A fortnight of concerts and street events around the national day of Galicia, with fireworks over the old town on the night of the 24th.
